cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/search/README.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'

Documents vhires_phase.c compile-time overrides (-DND -DNW -DNT -DP
-DBURN -DDLO -DDHI -DOUTBASE), output format, MMAX/runtime/size
